The Dreamers

Truly an act destined for headlining Glasto. The Dreamers marries both old and new material in perfect harmony for a stunning result. ✨🌙

About The Dreamers

The Dreamers are South East England’s answer to chart-topping tunes , all while embracing those epic classics . The Dreamers make delivering pop , folk , and timeless favourites look effortless. With each band member having honed their craft to perfection , all 3 musicians join forces to create a super band with all the right ingredients to deliver a performance that will have your guests’ jaws dropping, and bask in the pure talent before ultimately those feet, hips and arms take over—and everyone finds themselves on the dancefloor . Their standard lineup is lead female vocals with acoustic guitar , bass , and drums . They can upsize to a 4-piece with vocals/guitar, bass, keys , and drums for a more stripped-back acoustic feel. With kindness , warmth , and easygoing attitudes, The Dreamers are always ready to perform your favourite songs from their 400+ song repertoire . They bring everything needed for the show including PA , lights , and their A-game . The Dreamers will happily learn your first dance or special request and can even have their bassist double as a DJ for ticking all your entertainment needs in one fell swoop.
